messages.text: BL-1625 🎵 in progress — Two registered test populations are no role's lane - the shell suite manifest's 518 standing tests and the 1294 landed feature files under specs/features/ - so test_bl1388_land_step_guard_fixture.sh was red on main for thirteen days (BL-1624) and four landed promotion and portability features for three to four weeks (BL-1626, BL-1627) before incidental hand runs found them; one recorded lane runner executes a listed population one item at a time, appends one duration row per completed item, prints a verdict naming every red and the slowest, and exits with the suite's status, behind a shell-manifest front-end and a landed-features front-end - the recorder half, changing no lane set, with each population's first full run the census in the nightly slot after landing, never inside the parcel (absorbs BL-1628)
